newsitem.title: USA: Boeing off sharply after Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Boeing off sharply after Q1 results.

text.p: Boeing Co. shares fell sharply in early U.S. trade on Monday after the company reported first quarter results and the market reacted to a report of possible merger of Boeing competitors Lockheed Martin and Airbus Industrie.
Boeing shares opened at $95, down $7, on the New York Stock Exchange, contributing to a fall of 24 points in the Dow Jones industrial average, which was at 6,714 in early trading.
